name: NGC 3175 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3175, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3175-hubble
story: Lanes of dust, patches of glowing gas and pinwheeling arms wrap around the bright core of NGC 3175. It gives its name to a nearby galaxy group that has been called an analog of our own Local Group.

claims.text: Its image shows bright patches of glowing gas, dark lanes of dust, a bright core and whirling, pinwheeling arms
NGC 3175 is the eponymous member of the NGC 3175 group, called a nearby analogue of the Local Group
